verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only aggregate, read-side work across many items: Watchtower reviews every interaction against natural-language criteria and flags what matters, and Ask AI queries across all customer conversations. Nothing shows user-initiated bulk actions such as editing, tagging, closing or updating many items at once, and no public API or OpenAPI spec was found to script them. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/update/action capability, batch operations via API, documentation of bulk workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
